notes: Compatibility bridge for schema 098. Promote and accept while schema 097 is serving; all existing website and ecommerce behavior remains available while visit tracking fails open for public visitors and dashboard visit metrics report zero/unavailable. Only after this bridge is known-good may the separately locked automation create and verify a schema-097 backup, apply the pinned expand-only migration 098, and revalidate the active release. Schema 098 adds tenant-scoped atomic website and store opening counters without visitor identity or personal data. The retained schema-097 release remains a traffic rollback target only until migration begins; after schema advances to 098, forward repair is required by policy.
